notes: Cliopatria has no Stellaland or Goshen. One dossier covers both: the page 'Stellaland' (and British Bechuanaland) say the two republics merged in 1883 as the United States of Stellaland; the Goshen article did not load (Land_Goshen, Republic_of_Goshen and Goshen_(Boer_republic) all URL_NOT_FOUND), so Goshen's own founding (1882) is not dated here. The South African Republic's brief annexation of 16 September 1884 is in the war entry; the SAR dossier has no matching event. Counterparts without dossiers: Mankoroane's chiefdom (the Tlhaping) and Montshiwa's Rolong (the page does not name them). Gazetteer: Mmabatho stands in for Rooigrond; the British Bechuanaland region is used for the first-keyframe text only.
